causal_probe.scope: Causal real-data execution probe only; frame0 GT initialization, no rollout training or final tracking metrics.

scope: Quality/gain controller fit on all882 train sequences using current frozen fitted CNN and executor. Cycle the four query families; sample a valid proposal uniformly within the family. EvidencePairs creates offline GT-jittered search states and earlier GT templates; this is not a causal rollout. Proposal/head methods have no target argument; GT labels float32 signed image-clipped IoU differences after execution. Only8 quality/gain state tensors may change;257 stay frozen. No new C/dev/test/latency or three-mechanism effectiveness claim. Private labelled boxes/GT/CSV/weights stay private.
